about: The 166 pattern-note problems, in sheet order (Striver order inside each topic). One per pattern; takeaway = key idea and twists.

notes.title: Two Sum
notes.takeaway: Store what you've seen; check the complement in O(1) · twists: Group Anagrams — canonical key (sorted string or count tuple) · Longest Consecutive — start only where x−1 is missing · Top K Frequent — bucket by frequency

notes.title: Sort Colors
notes.takeaway: low / mid / high; don't advance mid after swapping with high · twists: First Missing Positive — cyclic sort, nums[i] belongs at index nums[i]−1 · Find All Duplicates — flip sign as a visited mark

notes.title: Majority Element
notes.takeaway: Cancel pairs; the candidate that survives wins · twist: Majority Element II (> n/3) — two candidates, then a verify pass

notes.title: Subarray Sum Equals K
notes.takeaway: count += seen[prefix − k], seed {0: 1} · twists: Contiguous Array — store the FIRST index for longest (0 → −1) · Divisible by K — key prefix % k, fix negative mod · XOR = K — same idea with prefix XOR (Count Subarrays with Given XOR)

notes.title: Product of Array Except Self
notes.takeaway: Left pass, then right pass with a running product; no division

notes.title: Find Missing and Repeated Values
notes.takeaway: Two equations (sum and sum of squares), or XOR split by the lowest set bit

notes.title: Count Inversions
notes.takeaway: While merging, if right < left add (mid − i + 1) · twist: Reverse Pairs counts a[i] > 2·a[j] in a separate pass before merging

notes.title: Find The Index of The First Occurrence in a String
notes.takeaway: Build the LPS array; the text pointer never moves back · twist: Shortest Palindrome — LPS of s + '#' + reverse(s) gives the longest palindromic prefix

notes.title: Container With Most Water
notes.takeaway: Move the shorter side · twists: Two Sum II — move by comparing the sum · Valid Palindrome II — on a mismatch try skipping left or right once

notes.title: Remove Duplicates From Sorted Array II
notes.takeaway: Write pointer k; keep nums[i] if it differs from nums[k−2] · twists: Move Zeroes — swap non-zeros forward · Merge Sorted Array — fill from the end

notes.title: Boats to Save People
notes.takeaway: Heaviest with the lightest if they fit · twist: Assign Cookies — the smallest cookie that satisfies

notes.title: 3Sum
notes.takeaway: Sort, fix i, two pointers on the rest, skip duplicates at every level · twist: 4Sum — two fixed loops, watch overflow

notes.title: Trapping Rain Water
notes.takeaway: water = min(maxL, maxR) − h; move the side whose max is smaller

notes.title: Permutation In String
notes.takeaway: Count array of size k; add the right, drop the left · twists: Find All Anagrams — collect starts · Max Points from Cards — total − min window of n−k

notes.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
notes.takeaway: Expand r; while invalid shrink l; ans = r − l + 1 · twists: Max Consecutive Ones III (zeros ≤ k) · Fruit Into Baskets (≤ 2 distinct) · Character Replacement — valid while len − maxFreq ≤ k; maxFreq never needs to decrease

notes.title: Subarrays with K Different Integers
notes.takeaway: exactly(K) = atMost(K) − atMost(K−1); atMost adds r − l + 1 · twists: Binary Subarrays with Sum · Nice Subarrays (odd → 1) · All Three Characters — add 1 + min(last a, b, c) per r · Product < K — add r − l + 1

notes.title: Minimum Window Substring
notes.takeaway: Expand until valid, then shrink while valid, recording the min · twist: Minimum Size Subarray Sum (positives only)

notes.title: Sliding Window Maximum
notes.takeaway: Deque of indices, values decreasing; pop the front when it leaves the window · twists: Abs Diff ≤ Limit — a max-deque and a min-deque · Shortest Subarray Sum ≥ K — increasing deque over prefix sums

notes.title: Valid Parentheses
notes.takeaway: Push openers, pop on a match · twists: Decode String — a count stack and a string stack · Evaluate RPN · Basic Calculator II — apply * and / at once, push ± numbers, sum at the end

notes.title: Implement Queue using Stacks
notes.takeaway: Move in → out only when out is empty (amortised O(1)) · twists: Stack using Queues · Max Frequency Stack — a stack per frequency

notes.title: Min Stack
notes.takeaway: Store (value, current min) pairs, or encode 2·val − min

notes.title: Daily Temperatures
notes.takeaway: Decreasing stack of indices; a pop resolves the answer · twists: circular — loop 2n with i % n (Next Greater Element II) · Online Stock Span — previous greater · 132 Pattern — track the popped value as 'the 2' · Asteroid Collision, Car Fleet — stack simulation

notes.title: Sum of Subarray Minimums
notes.takeaway: Each element × left span × right span; strict on one side, non-strict on the other · twist: sum of subarray ranges = Σmax − Σmin

notes.title: Largest Rectangle In Histogram
notes.takeaway: On pop: width = i − stack.top − 1 · twist: Maximal Rectangle = a histogram per row

notes.title: Remove K Digits
notes.takeaway: Pop while top > current and k > 0; trim the tail if k remains; strip leading zeros

notes.title: Find First And Last Position of Element In Sorted Array
notes.takeaway: lower_bound / upper_bound templates; keep an answer variable instead of returning early · twists: Search Insert = lower bound · Kth Missing — missing = a[i] − (i+1), answer = lo + k · Time Based Key-Value Store — upper bound on timestamps

notes.title: Search a 2D Matrix
notes.takeaway: Treat the matrix as one sorted array · twists: Kth Smallest Pair Distance — search the value, count pairs ≤ mid with two pointers · Random Pick with Weight — prefix sums + lower bound · Spells and Potions — sort + bound

notes.title: Search In Rotated Sorted Array
notes.takeaway: One half is always sorted — check whether the target lies in it · twists: with duplicates, if a[lo] == a[mid] == a[hi] shrink both ends · Find Minimum — compare mid with hi

notes.title: Single Element in a Sorted Array
notes.takeaway: Pair-index parity tells which side · twists: Find Peak — always go uphill · Mountain Array — find the peak, then search both sides

notes.title: Koko Eating Bananas
notes.takeaway: Search the answer range; check(x) is monotonic · twists: Capacity to Ship · max of min — Aggressive Cows · min of max — Split Array Largest Sum · sqrt / nth root — watch mid^n overflow

notes.title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
notes.takeaway: Binary search the cut on the smaller array; valid when l1 ≤ r2 and l2 ≤ r1 · twist: k-th element of two arrays is the same cut

notes.title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
notes.takeaway: Move fast n ahead; the dummy handles deleting the head · twists: Rotate List — length, join tail to head, cut at len − k % len · Odd Even List — two tails, then join

notes.title: Reverse Linked List
notes.takeaway: prev / cur / next · twists: Reverse II — dummy, reverse a sublist · Reverse in K-Group — check k nodes exist first · Swap Pairs = k of 2

notes.title: Palindrome Linked List
notes.takeaway: Find the middle, reverse the second half, compare, restore · twist: Reorder List weaves the reversed half in

notes.title: Intersection of Two Linked Lists
notes.takeaway: Switch heads at the end so both walk equal lengths · twist: Add Two Numbers — dummy + carry

notes.title: Linked List Cycle II
notes.takeaway: Meet, then move one pointer to head; they meet at the cycle start · twists: Middle (choose first or second middle) · Find the Duplicate Number — Floyd on indices

notes.title: Merge K Sorted Lists
notes.takeaway: Min-heap of the list heads · twist: Design Twitter merges k feeds

notes.title: Sort List
notes.takeaway: Merge sort: split at the middle, merge two sorted · twists: Merge Two Sorted · Flattening a Linked List — merge the down-lists pairwise · Merge K — min-heap

notes.title: Copy List With Random Pointer
notes.takeaway: Interleave copies, set copy.random = orig.random.next, then unweave (or a hash map)

notes.title: LRU Cache
notes.takeaway: key → node; move to front on get / put, evict the tail · twists: LFU — freq → list + minFreq · Browser History

notes.title: Binary Tree Inorder Traversal
notes.takeaway: Recursive · iterative (push the left chain) · Morris (thread the predecessor, O(1) space) · twist: iterative postorder with two stacks

notes.title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
notes.takeaway: Queue + level size · twists: Zigzag — reverse alternate levels · Right Side View — last of each level · Max Width — index 2i+1 / 2i+2, minus the level's first · Check Completeness — no node after a null

notes.title: Diameter of Binary Tree
notes.takeaway: Return the height, update the answer at each node · twists: Balanced — return −1 to stop · Max Path Sum — drop negative branches · House Robber III — return (rob, skip)

notes.title: Same Tree
notes.takeaway: Recurse on both together · twists: Symmetric — compare mirrored · Subtree of Another · Find Duplicate Subtrees — serialise every subtree into a map

notes.title: Vertical Order Traversal of a Binary Tree
notes.takeaway: Traverse with (col, row); map col → nodes, sorted · twists: Top View — first per column · Bottom View — last per column · Boundary — left edge + leaves + reversed right edge

notes.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
notes.takeaway: Return the node if found; both sides non-null → this node · twists: Path Sum, Sum Root to Leaf — pass the running value down · root-to-node path with backtracking

notes.title: All Nodes Distance K in Binary Tree
notes.takeaway: Build parent pointers, then BFS from the target like a graph · twist: Amount of Time to Infect = the number of BFS levels

notes.title: Construct Binary Tree From Preorder And Inorder Traversal
notes.takeaway: Root from preorder, split by an inorder index map · twists: Inorder + Postorder (build right first) · Serialise with null markers · Flatten to Linked List (reverse postorder with prev) · Count Complete Tree Nodes — equal left/right heights → 2^h − 1

notes.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
notes.takeaway: Pass (min, max) bounds · twists: inorder is sorted → Kth Smallest, Recover BST (two swapped nodes) · BST from Preorder (upper bound) · BST Iterator (push the left chain) · Two Sum in BST (two iterators) · LCA in BST (split point) · Delete (inorder successor) · Max Sum BST — postorder returns (min, max, sum, isBST)

notes.title: Unique Binary Search Trees
notes.takeaway: G(n) = Σ G(i−1) · G(n−i) over each root i

notes.title: Implement Trie Prefix Tree
notes.takeaway: children[26] + end flag · twists: counts per node for countPrefix / erase · Longest Word in Dictionary — every node on the path must end a word

notes.title: Word Search II
notes.takeaway: DFS the grid while walking the trie; prune found words · twists: Add and Search Words — '.' tries every child · Extra Characters — trie + DP over the start index

notes.title: Maximum XOR of Two Numbers in an Array
notes.takeaway: Insert bits high → low; greedily take the opposite bit · twist: Max XOR with an Element — sort queries by limit, insert offline

notes.title: Kth Largest Element In An Array
notes.takeaway: Min-heap of size k (or quickselect) · twists: Kth Largest in a Stream · K Closest Points — max-heap of size k · Top K Frequent · Last Stone Weight — simulate with a max-heap

notes.title: Task Scheduler
notes.takeaway: Most frequent first; idle = (maxF − 1)·(n + 1) formula · twists: Reorganize String — place the top two · Single Threaded CPU, IPO — sort by time / capital, push what's available · Furthest Building — min-heap of ladder jumps · Car Pooling — sweep

notes.title: Find Median From Data Stream
notes.takeaway: Max-heap for the low half, min-heap for the high half; rebalance sizes

notes.title: Generate Parentheses
notes.takeaway: Add '(' while open < n, ')' while close < open · twist: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number

notes.title: Subsets II
notes.takeaway: Pick / not pick; sort and skip equal values at the same level · twists: Subsets (bitmask works too) · Combination Sum — reuse, stay at i · Combination Sum II — move to i+1, skip duplicates · Combinations

notes.title: Permutations II
notes.takeaway: used[] + skip a value equal to the previous unused one · twists: swap method · Permutation Sequence — factorial blocks, no backtracking

notes.title: N Queens
notes.takeaway: Row by row with column / diagonal sets (r − c, r + c) · twists: Sudoku Solver — try 1–9, check row, column, box · M-Coloring — try each colour, check neighbours

notes.title: Word Search
notes.takeaway: Mark visited in place, restore on return

notes.title: Partition to K Equal Sum Subsets
notes.takeaway: Sort descending; skip identical empty buckets · twist: Matchsticks to Square = 4 buckets

notes.title: Palindrome Partitioning
notes.takeaway: Cut at every end index where the prefix is valid · twists: Restore IP — 4 parts, 0–255, no leading zeros · Word Break II — memo by start index

notes.title: Find the Town Judge
notes.takeaway: in − out == n − 1 (the Celebrity problem)

notes.title: Clone Graph
notes.takeaway: DFS with an old → new map; the map doubles as visited

notes.title: Evaluate Division
notes.takeaway: a → b weight v and b → a weight 1/v; DFS multiplying along the path

notes.title: Number of Provinces
notes.takeaway: Count how many times a DFS / BFS has to start · twist: Number of Connected Components

notes.title: Number of Islands
notes.takeaway: 4 directions; mark visited in place · twists: Flood Fill — skip if the new colour equals the old · Max Area of Island

notes.title: Rotting Oranges
notes.takeaway: Push every source first; each level is a minute · twists: Walls and Gates · 0/1 Matrix (distance of the nearest 1)

notes.title: Shortest Bridge
notes.takeaway: DFS-mark the first island, multi-source BFS to the second

notes.title: Graph Valid Tree
notes.takeaway: BFS / DFS carrying the parent; a tree has n − 1 edges and is connected

notes.title: Minimum Height Trees
notes.takeaway: Peel leaves layer by layer; the last 1–2 nodes are the centres

notes.title: Surrounded Regions
notes.takeaway: Mark from the border, flip the rest · twists: Number of Enclaves · Pacific Atlantic — two reverse flows, intersect

notes.title: Number of Distinct Islands
notes.takeaway: Store each cell relative to the island's first cell; a set of shapes

notes.title: Is Graph Bipartite?
notes.takeaway: 2-colour by BFS / DFS; an odd cycle fails; run from every uncoloured node

notes.title: Course Schedule
notes.takeaway: DFS with visited + path-visited (on the current path) · or Kahn: fewer than n nodes processed

notes.title: Find Eventual Safe States
notes.takeaway: Safe = not on and not leading to a cycle · or reverse the graph + Kahn from terminal nodes

notes.title: Course Schedule II
notes.takeaway: Indegree queue; the pop order is the answer; size < n means a cycle

notes.title: Shortest Path in Binary Matrix
notes.takeaway: 8 directions; set the distance when pushing, not when popping

notes.title: Word Ladder
notes.takeaway: Change each char a–z; remove a word from the set once visited · twists: Word Ladder II — parents per level, then backtrack · Open the Lock

notes.title: Accounts Merge
notes.takeaway: Union by rank + path compression; union each email to its owner · twists: Redundant Connection — first edge inside one set · Most Stones Removed · Operations to Make Network Connected

notes.title: Alien Dictionary
notes.takeaway: The first differing char of adjacent words is an edge; a longer word before its prefix is invalid

notes.title: Shortest Path in Directed Acyclic Graph
notes.takeaway: Topological order, then relax edges in that order — O(V + E), negative weights fine

notes.title: Network Delay Time
notes.takeaway: Min-heap of (dist, node); skip stale entries; the answer is the max distance

notes.title: Bus Routes
notes.takeaway: BFS over routes, not stops; stop → routes map; visit each route once

notes.title: Minimum Obstacle Removal to Reach Corner
notes.takeaway: Deque: weight 0 → push front, weight 1 → push back

notes.title: Path with Minimum Effort
notes.takeaway: Path cost = max edge so far; still Dijkstra · twists: Swim in Rising Water · Path with Maximum Probability — max-heap, multiply

notes.title: Trapping Rain Water II
notes.takeaway: Push every border cell; pop the lowest, fill neighbours up to its height

notes.title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
notes.pattern: Shortest path with a stop limit
notes.takeaway: Queue ordered by stops, not cost (plain Dijkstra fails) · or Bellman-Ford for k + 1 rounds

notes.title: Number of Ways to Arrive at Destination
notes.takeaway: Equal distance → add ways; shorter → reset ways; mod 1e9+7

notes.title: Bellman-Ford
notes.takeaway: Relax every edge V − 1 times; a change on round V means a negative cycle

notes.title: Find the City With the Smallest Number of Neighbors at a Threshold Distance
notes.takeaway: k is the outer loop: dist[i][j] = min(dist[i][j], dist[i][k] + dist[k][j])

notes.title: Min Cost to Connect All Points
notes.takeaway: Prim with a min-heap (dense graph) · or Kruskal: sort edges + DSU

notes.title: Making A Large Island
notes.takeaway: Size per root; for each 0, sum the distinct neighbouring roots + 1

notes.title: Reconstruct Itinerary
notes.takeaway: DFS, append on backtrack, reverse; a min-heap per node for lexical order

notes.title: Strongly Connected Components (Kosaraju's Algorithm)
notes.takeaway: Kosaraju: finish-time stack, reverse the graph, DFS in stack order

notes.title: Critical Connections in a Network
notes.takeaway: tin / low; low[child] > tin[node] → bridge

notes.title: Articulation Point - I
notes.takeaway: low[child] ≥ tin[node] for a non-root, or a root with more than one DFS child

notes.title: Climbing Stairs
notes.takeaway: dp[i] = dp[i−1] + dp[i−2]; recursion → memo → table → two variables · twists: Frog Jump K — min over the last k · Min Cost Climbing Stairs

notes.title: Decode Ways
notes.takeaway: One-digit and two-digit transitions; '0' can't stand alone

notes.title: House Robber
notes.takeaway: dp[i] = max(dp[i−1], a[i] + dp[i−2]) · twist: Delete and Earn — bucket the values, then rob

notes.title: House Robber II
notes.takeaway: Run twice: without the first, without the last

notes.title: Maximum Product Subarray
notes.takeaway: Track both the max and the min; a negative swaps them

notes.title: Geek's Training
notes.pattern: Choice per day with a 'last' state
notes.takeaway: Striver's Ninja's Training · dp[day][last]; try every task ≠ last

notes.title: Triangle
notes.takeaway: Bottom-up from the last row; O(n) space

notes.title: Word Break
notes.takeaway: dp[i] true if some dp[j] and s[j..i) is a word · twist: Word Break II returns every split

notes.title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
notes.takeaway: dp[i][t] take / not take; the total must be even

notes.title: Coin Change
notes.takeaway: Stay on the same index after taking · twist: Perfect Squares

notes.title: Combination Sum IV
notes.takeaway: Target outer loop, nums inner (order matters) — the opposite of Coin Change II

notes.title: Minimum Cost For Tickets
notes.takeaway: dp[day] = min(1-day, 7-day, 30-day pass looking back)

notes.title: Longest Palindromic Substring
notes.takeaway: Expand from each odd and even centre · twist: Palindromic Substrings counts every expansion

notes.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
notes.takeaway: dp[i] = 1 + max dp[j] for a[j] < a[i]; a parent array prints it

notes.title: Russian Doll Envelopes
notes.takeaway: Sort width ascending, height descending; LIS on heights with a tails array

notes.title: Maximum Profit in Job Scheduling
notes.takeaway: Sort by end; dp = max(skip, profit + dp[last non-overlapping job])

notes.title: Largest Divisible Subset
notes.pattern: LIS on sorted with a condition + print
notes.takeaway: Sort; condition a[i] % a[j] == 0; parent array to print

notes.title: Longest String Chain
notes.takeaway: Sort by length; predecessor = delete one char

notes.title: Minimum Number of Removals to Make Mountain Array
notes.takeaway: LIS from the left + LIS from the right − 1; both sides must be > 1

notes.title: Number of Longest Increasing Subsequence
notes.takeaway: count[i] adds on an equal length, resets on a longer one

notes.title: Partition Array for Maximum Sum
notes.takeaway: dp[i] = max over the last block length ≤ k

notes.title: Unique Paths
notes.takeaway: dp[i][j] = up + left · twist: Unique Paths II — 0 on obstacles

notes.title: Minimum Path Sum
notes.takeaway: min(up, left) + cell; first row and column are prefix sums

notes.title: Minimum Falling Path Sum
notes.takeaway: Try every start column; three moves down

notes.title: Minimum Falling Path Sum II
notes.takeaway: Keep the smallest and second smallest of the previous row

notes.title: Cherry Pickup II
notes.takeaway: State (row, c1, c2); 9 move pairs; don't count a shared cell twice

notes.title: Cherry Pickup
notes.pattern: Round trip as two forward walks
notes.takeaway: State (r1, c1, r2), c2 derived from the step; blocked cells end the path

notes.title: Last Stone Weight II
notes.takeaway: All reachable sums ≤ total / 2; answer = total − 2 · best

notes.title: Ones and Zeroes
notes.takeaway: dp[m][n]; iterate both capacities backwards

notes.title: Target Sum
notes.takeaway: Count subsets summing to (total + target) / 2; zeros double the count

notes.title: Coin Change II
notes.takeaway: Coins in the outer loop so a combination isn't counted twice · twist: Rod Cutting — max value

notes.title: Longest Common Subsequence
notes.takeaway: Match → 1 + diagonal, else max(up, left) · twist: min insertions + deletions to convert = n + m − 2 · LCS

notes.title: Maximum Length of Repeated Subarray
notes.takeaway: On a mismatch the cell is 0; the answer is the max cell

notes.title: Longest Palindromic Subsequence
notes.takeaway: LPS = LCS(s, reverse(s)) · twist: min insertions to make a palindrome = n − LPS

notes.title: Shortest Common Supersequence
notes.takeaway: Walk back from (n, m), adding unmatched chars

notes.title: Distinct Subsequences
notes.takeaway: On a match dp[i−1][j−1] + dp[i−1][j]; use long / mod

notes.title: Edit Distance
notes.takeaway: insert (i, j−1), delete (i−1, j), replace (i−1, j−1)

notes.title: Interleaving String
notes.takeaway: dp[i][j] from s1 or s2 whose char matches s3[i+j−1]

notes.title: Wildcard Matching
notes.takeaway: '*' = empty (j−1) or one more char (i−1); base: a prefix of stars matches empty

notes.title: Regular Expression Matching
notes.takeaway: '*' = zero of the previous (j−2), or one more if the previous char matches

notes.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock IV
notes.takeaway: State (i, holding, trades left) · twist: Stock III = k of 2

notes.title: Best Time to Buy And Sell Stock With Cooldown
notes.takeaway: After a sell, the next buy looks at i + 2

notes.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Transaction Fee
notes.takeaway: dp[i][holding]; pay the fee on sell · twist: Stock II = no fee

notes.title: Minimum Cost to Cut a Stick
notes.takeaway: Add 0 and n, sort the cuts; f(i, j) = min over k of cost + f(i, k) + f(k, j) · twist: Matrix Chain Multiplication

notes.title: Burst Balloons
notes.takeaway: Choose the balloon burst LAST in (i, j); pad with 1s

notes.title: Boolean Parenthesization
notes.takeaway: f(i, j, wantTrue) split at each operator; combine counts by the operator; mod

notes.title: Palindrome Partitioning II
notes.takeaway: dp[i] = min cuts; precompute isPal[i][j]; answer − 1

notes.title: Maximal Square
notes.takeaway: dp = 1 + min(up, left, diagonal) · twist: Count Square Submatrices sums every dp cell

notes.title: Longest Increasing Path In a Matrix
notes.takeaway: Strictly increasing means no cycles, so no visited set; memo per cell

notes.title: Maximum Subarray
notes.takeaway: Extend or restart; keep the best · twists: Circular — max(kadane, total − min-kadane), all-negative case · Max Product — keep both max and min, swap on a negative

notes.title: Jump Game II
notes.takeaway: BFS by levels: current end and farthest · twist: Jump Game — track the max reach

notes.title: Gas Station
notes.takeaway: If the tank goes negative restart after i; total ≥ 0 means an answer exists

notes.title: Maximum Length of Pair Chain
notes.takeaway: Sort by end; take if start > last end · twists: N meetings in one room · Job Sequencing — sort by profit, latest free slot ≤ deadline · Fractional Knapsack — sort by value/weight, take a fraction of the last

notes.title: Partition Labels
notes.takeaway: Record each char's last index; cut when i reaches the current farthest end

notes.title: Next Permutation
notes.takeaway: Find the first dip from the right, swap with the next larger from the right, reverse the suffix

notes.title: Valid Parenthesis String
notes.takeaway: Track min and max open; fail if max < 0, clamp min at 0 · twists: Lemonade Change — prefer giving a 10 · Hand of Straights — start from the smallest, use counts

notes.title: Candy
notes.takeaway: Left pass, right pass, take the max

notes.title: Merge Intervals
notes.takeaway: Sort by start, extend the last end · twists: Insert Interval — before, overlap, after · Interval List Intersections — two pointers, advance the smaller end

notes.title: Non Overlapping Intervals
notes.takeaway: Keep the earliest end; count removals · twist: Minimum Arrows — the same, counting groups

notes.title: Meeting Rooms II
notes.takeaway: Min-heap of end times, or sorted starts and ends · twists: Meeting Rooms III — heaps of free rooms and busy rooms by end time · Min Interval per Query — sort queries, heap by size

notes.title: Multiply Strings
notes.takeaway: res[i+j+1] += d1·d2, then carry · twists: Plus One · Roman conversions — greedy by value · Happy Number — Floyd on numbers

notes.title: Count Primes
notes.takeaway: Sieve from i·i · twists: Pow(x, n) — fast power, negative n · smallest prime factor sieve for factorisation · divisors up to √n

notes.title: Rotate Image
notes.takeaway: Transpose, then reverse each row · twists: Spiral — four boundaries · Set Matrix Zeroes — first row and column as markers

notes.title: Maximum Points on a Line
notes.takeaway: Slope as a reduced (dy, dx) pair via gcd · twist: Detect Squares — count diagonals

notes.title: Find the Winner of the Circular Game
Number of 1 Bits
notes.takeaway: n & (n−1) clears the lowest set bit · twists: Power of Two · Counting Bits — dp[i] = dp[i >> 1] + (i & 1) · Minimum Bit Flips = popcount(a ^ b) · Reverse Bits

notes.title: Sum of Two Integers
notes.takeaway: sum = a ^ b, carry = (a & b) << 1 · twists: Divide Two Integers — subtract shifted divisors, the overflow case · Bitwise AND of a Range — common prefix

notes.title: Single Number III
notes.takeaway: XOR everything, split by the lowest set bit (x & −x) · twists: Single Number · Missing Number · XOR of 1..n by n % 4 · Single Number II — count each bit mod 3
